text:
incident-bot: Pager: autoscaler -> SAFETY_STOP triggered for cluster prod-usw2 at 2234567890. Reason: approaching cluster maxNodes (configured limit). Queue growth observed for GPU inference; latency rising. Paging on-call.
ops-oncall: I'm on it. seeing queue spike for model-gen-high: pending=11.2k, avg latency=1.4s, 429s start to show. tagging @sre-marc @infra-anna
sre-marc: joining. can you drop the full logs/metrics link? also which pools are saturated? @prod-eng-lee FYI
ops-oncall: metrics: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/gpu-queue?from=-15m
ops-oncall: node pools: gpu-large-prod (maxNodes=40) at 100%, gpu-burst (maxNodes=10) at 100%, some jobs queued in priority=low
infra-anna: autoscaler safety stop kicked because cluster-level pod count would exceed quota; cluster-autoscaler refused to scale. policy: safety_stop=true when nodeCount>45
infra-anna: I'm seeing repeated CA logs: "scaleUp forbidden: would exceed maxNodes" and also kube-controller-manager rejecting due to pod limit per node type.
sre-marc: immediate mitigations: 1) enable temporary override for autoscaler maxNodes 2) drain low-priority workloads / cordon dev pools 3) apply request-level throttling for non-prod tenants
prod-eng-lee: can we fallback heavy workloads to lower-capacity quantized model to reduce GPU consumption? we have a vqfp-approx model that halves token cost.
customer-success-jay: heads-up: two customers (acme-inc, fintech-ops) reported errors. CS has opened tickets and staging alerts.
ops-oncall: creating a temporary override request now. pinging @infra-anna for approval.
infra-anna: approve. I'll run the override but want to limit TTL to 25m and monitor. command:

```
# temporary override via infra CLI
rictl autoscaler override --cluster prod-usw2 --set maxNodes=70 --reason "2234567890 incident: safety stop override" --ttl 25m
```

infra-anna: executing now.
infra-anna: override applied. cluster target maxNodes=70. CA logs: "safety stop cleared by operator override"
ops-oncall: scaling observed: +18 nodes requested, kube cloud provider provisioning ongoing. provisioning ETA ~4m per cloud events. queue length dropping slowly.
sre-marc: while nodes ramp, start draining noncritical workloads from gpu-burst: `kubectl drain node-spot-*-dev --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
prod-eng-lee: rolling out quantized fallback config to reduce bursty jobs for model-gen-high. patch:

```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap model-routing --patch '{"data":{"model-gen-high":"vqfp-approx"}}'
```

prod-eng-lee: applied.
ops-oncall: impact update: latency for model-gen-high peaked at 1.8s, now 900ms; 429 rate dropped from 7% -> 1.1% in 8m. customers still affected but improving.
customer-success-jay: notifying Acme and Fintech about temporary degradation and mitigation steps. sending ETA ~20m.
pagerduty-bot: Incident 2234567890 acknowledged by oncall (ops-oncall). Priority: P2. Pager duty link: https://pd.redwood/incidents/2234567890
sre-marc: important: after nodes stabilize we need to remove override and revert routing to normal. also start post-incident eval on autoscaler policy thresholds and pod limits.
infra-anna: new nodes are Ready. cloud events show 18 instances added. kube-scheduler placing pods.
ops-oncall: queue backlog now 2.1k pending, avg latency 420ms. continuing to monitor.
prod-eng-lee: reverting fallback for non-critical tenants in 10m when we confirm stable.
ops-oncall: starting on-call handoff to @sre-marc in 15m; I'm reassigning primary.
ops-oncall: handoff: summary:
- cause: cluster-autoscaler safety_stop when approaching maxNodes/quota
- impact: increased latencies and 429s for GPU inference tenant workloads
- mitigation: infra override increased maxNodes from 50->70 (ttl 25m), drained low-priority dev pools, applied quantized model fallback
- current state: nodes added, queue draining, latency improving
sre-marc: taking over. I'll watch until override TTL expires and coordinate ramp-down. tagging @infra-anna for scheduled revert.
infra-anna: note: manual override recorded in audit log id=aud-2234567890; will remove override at 2234568150 unless extended. command to remove early:

```
rictl autoscaler override --cluster prod-usw2 --clear --reason "revert after stabilization"
```

sre-marc: suggest we start customer-impact postmortem doc. @customer-success-jay please paste any customer messages into the doc.
customer-success-jay: will do, sending updates now.
sre-marc: override TTL expired; removing override.
infra-anna: cleared override at 2234568205. CA now enforcing configured maxNodes again (50). monitoring for requeue.
ops-oncall: rebalancing: drained extra spot nodes, deprovisioning in progress.
ops-oncall: final metrics: pending=120, avg latency=340ms, 429s <0.1% in last 5m.
sre-marc: closing incident channel for active mitigation. follow-ups: (1) increase cluster maxNodes threshold for prod-usw2 or adjust safety_stop policy (2) add automated graceful fallback routing when queue>5k (3) run capacity test for peak scenarios
sre-marc: filing postmortem ticket: https://pm.redwood/incidents/2234567890-postmortem
ops-oncall: thanks everyone. :tada:
customer-success-jay: informed customers that services are restored; offering credit for the window.
incident-bot: Incident 2234567890: mitigated and monitor-only. thread closed at 2234568250."
